description:
## Summary
Port the `/new` command, which is missing from octo_pi's autocomplete and command dispatcher.

## Observed Upstream Behavior
`/new` starts a fresh session, identical in effect to pressing Ctrl+C twice in the editor.

Behavior details:
- Dispatches to `handleClearCommand()` — same handler as double Ctrl+C
- Calls `runtimeHost.newSession()` to create and switch to a new session file
- Clears the transcript display
- Shows status: `accent("✓ New session started")`
- Any in-progress streaming is interrupted before clearing

On-screen cue: green checkmark confirmation line in the transcript area.

## Source References
- Handler: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts` ~line 5252 `handleClearCommand()`
- Dispatch: same file, search for `"new"` in the slash-command router
- Command registration: `tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/slash-commands.ts` — entry `"new"`

## What to Implement in Elixir
1. Add `"new"` to `builtin_commands/0` in `autocomplete.ex`
2. Add `/new` dispatch clause that calls the same handler as the double-Ctrl+C clear path
3. Show `accent("✓ New session started")` status after the new session is initialized
title: Port /new command
